title: Finite polynomial stages present the rank-one translation module as an ind-unipotent colimit
statement:
Fix a prime $\ell$, an algebraic closure $\Omega/\mathbf Q_\ell$ with its extended norm topology, a finite intermediate field $E$, and $F=E$ or $F=\Omega$. On the coherent profinite site put $A(S)=C(S,F)$, using all continuous functions [def-sfb-continuous-map-condensed-ring] and the compatible universes of [def-weil-size-convention]. Fix integers $r\geq1$ and $m\geq0$. Put $G=\mathbf Z_\ell^{r-1}$ and $H=\mathbf Z_\ell$, with their inverse-limit topologies. Let $T$ be the internal direct sum of copies of $A$ indexed by monomials in $y_1,\ldots,y_r,z_1,\ldots,z_m$ [def-weil-pbc-mv-polynomial-ring], an internal $A$-module [sk-def-sfb-module-objects]. Its internal $A$-linear $G\times H$-action is translation by $-t$ in $y_1$ for $t\in H$, translation by the negative $G$ coordinates in $y_2,\ldots,y_r$, and the identity on the $z_j$ [def-sfb-condensed-action-module]. These formulas hold for varying continuous group parameters on every profinite test set.

For $n\geq0$ let $V_n\subset E[y_1,\ldots,y_r,z_1,\ldots,z_m]$ be the span of monomials of total degree at most $n$, with its finite-dimensional norm topology. Let $i_n:V_n\to V_{n+1}$ be the inclusion, $D_n=-\partial/\partial y_1$ on $V_n$, $e_n=n+1$, and $\rho_n$ the $G\times H$-representation on $V_n$ by the same translations. Then $(V_n,i_n,D_n,e_n,\rho_n)$ is a finite ind-unipotent system for $G$ and $H$ in the sense of [def-sfb-ind-unipotent-system]. The $i_n$ are injective and equivariant with $i_nD_n=D_{n+1}i_n$. Each translation preserves $V_n$, its matrix entries in the monomial basis are polynomial functions of the group coordinates, and $\rho_n$ is continuous. Moreover $D_n^{n+1}=0$, $D_n$ commutes with $G$, and for every $t\in\mathbf Z_\ell$ the finite Taylor identity
$$\sum_{j=0}^{n}\frac{t^jD_n^j f}{j!}=f(y_1-t,y_2,\ldots,y_r,z)\qquad(f\in V_n)$$
holds, so $\rho_n(1,t)=\exp(tD_n)$.

Set $M_n(S)=C(S,F\otimes_E V_n)$, with the finite-dimensional product norm topology on $F\otimes_E V_n$ and the induced $G\times H$-action. Coefficient projections in the monomial basis give $G\times H$-equivariant internal isomorphisms of $M_n$ with the sub-direct-sum $\bigoplus_{|\alpha|\leq n}A$ of $T$, compatible with the transitions $F\otimes_E i_n$ and the inclusions of sub-sums. Consequently the colimit $M=\operatorname{colim}_nM_n$, formed in internal $A$-modules with its induced $G\times H$-action, is equivariantly isomorphic to $T$, with each monomial coprojection preserved. Under this isomorphism the induced endomorphism $D$ of $M$ is $-\partial/\partial y_1$ on $T$, and for $\tau=1\in H$
$$\tau-1=\exp(D)-1=\Delta,\qquad \Delta f=f(y_1-1,y_2,\ldots,z)-f(y_1,y_2,\ldots,z),$$
a finite sum on each monomial. This includes $r=1$, $m=0$ and $n=0$; it imposes no degree bound on $T$ and no completeness assumption on $\Omega$.

The first coefficient homomorphism is identity and continuous; the second is the continuous subtype inclusion of an intermediate field. Pair the two assertions with the same Q, proving the original existential and conjunction.
